learningObjectives: Create reusable Java methods with parameters and return values.
Distinguish local variables, parameters, and return values.
Decompose a program into smaller reusable methods.

activities.title: Method Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each part of the method declaration.

content.concept: A Java method declaration can contain an access modifier, return type, method name, parameters, and a method body.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Method Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of a method call.

content.concept: A method call transfers control to the method, supplies arguments, executes its body, and may return a value.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Parameter Matcher
activities.instruction: Match arguments with their method parameters.

content.concept: Parameters define the values a method receives, while arguments provide those values when the method is called.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Method Builder
activities.instruction: Compose a reusable method from the given requirements.

content.concept: Breaking logic into focused methods improves reuse, readability, and maintainability.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
